answers.question: What is the purpose of splitting a dataset into training and testing sets?
answers.answer: Splitting a dataset into training and testing sets is essential in machine learning to evaluate how well a model generalizes to unseen data and to prevent overfitting. The model learns patterns and adjusts its parameters using the training set, while the testing set acts as an unbiased benchmark that simulates real-world performance on new inputs. By keeping the test data completely separate during the training phase, data scientists can accurately detect whether a model has truly learned underlying trends or merely memorized the training examples.
